verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a first-party User Memory feature (docs-26), and the product is self-hosted via Docker or npm on the user's own machine (docs-35, docs-48), so any remembered data stays on infrastructure the user controls. The evidence is only a page title, though, and says nothing about how users view or manage memories. missing for 10: documented UI or API to inspect memories, documented editing of memory entries, documented deletion of memories, evidence the memory store uses an open or exportable format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
